segments.label: motivation

segments.text: — where after each pruning round the surviving weights are not rewound to their initialization and all finetuning uses only the potentially poisoned dataset $\mathcal{D}_\mathrm{p}$ (no clean data) —
segments.label: elaboration
of_terms: the specific iterative magnitude pruning (IMP) regime adopted for Trojan analysis

segments.text: the Trojan score is defined to quantify the pruning-induced stability of Trojan tickets by measuring the linear-mode connectivity (LMC) error barrier between the un-finetuned Trojan ticket $(m\odot\theta)$ and the $k$-step finetuned Trojan ticket $(m\odot\theta^{(k)})$.
segments.label: motivation

segments.text: Here, $\theta$ are the parameters of the dense model trained on $\mathcal{D}_\mathrm{p}$, $m\in\{0,1\}^d$ is the binary pruning mask, $\odot$ denotes elementwise product, and $\theta^{(k)}$ denotes $\theta$ after $k$ gradient steps of finetuning on $\mathcal{D}_\mathrm{p}$.
segments.label: elaboration

segments.text: Given a model training error functional $\mathcal{E}(\cdot)$ evaluated on $\mathcal{D}_\mathrm{p}$, the LMC error barrier is $$e_{\sup}(\phi_1,\phi_2)=\max_{\alpha\in[0,1]}\mathcal{E}(\alpha\phi_1+(1-\alpha)\phi_2).$$
segments.label: elaboration

segments.text: Setting $\phi_1 = m\odot\theta$ and $\phi_2 = m\odot\theta^{(k)}$, the Trojan score is $$\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{Trojan}} \;=\; e_{\sup}(m\odot\theta,\;m\odot\theta^{(k)}) \;-\; \frac{\mathcal{E}(m\odot\theta)+\mathcal{E}(m\odot\theta^{(k)})}{2}.$$
segments.label: elaboration

segments.text: Under the described IMP regime, the Trojan score is approximately zero for non-Trojan (clean) models
segments.label: assertion

segments.text: because the linear interpolation error barrier equals the average of the endpoints' errors.
segments.label: 论证

segments.text: A significantly positive peak in $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{Trojan}}$ along the pruning path indicates an atypical pruning stability fingerprint associated with a backdoor.
segments.label: assertion

segments.text: computing $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{Trojan}}$ along the IMP pruning path yields a data-free detector that identifies pruning levels where Trojan information is isolated.
segments.label: assertion
